title: NFV, SDN, Docker and High Availability on AWS

src: Source: Lecture 03 (67 slides, mostly images, all read as rendered slides).
lead: Lecture 03: Network Functions Virtualization, SDN, Citrix / Akasa / Dialog cloud examples, containers and Docker (images, containers, Dockerfile layers, registries, volumes), AWS regions and availability zones, a highly available 3-tier architecture, capacity planning, scaling, launch templates, auto scaling policies, RDS vs EC2, and disaster recovery with RTO / RPO (backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby, multi-site).
